newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore port spends S$335 million in 46 cranes.
newsitem.headline: Singapore port spends S$335 million in 46 cranes.

text.p: The Port Authority of Singapore (PSA) has spent Singapore $335 million on 46 new cranes for its Pasir Panjang terminal, state television said on Thursday.
The new terminal, located on the western part of Singapore, is scheduled to become operational early next year.
The television report said new quay cranes were designed to handle the latest generation of ships while new overhead bridge cranes were the world's first remote-controlled yard cranes.
Productivity was expected to be raised by at least 30 percent, it quoted the PSA as saying.
